user_reported_bug: Rota email debug use resend still showing smtp
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI and backend verification confirms the rota email debug flow now reports Resend as the active transport. UI modal showed 'Transport: Resend (HTTPS)', Resend sender, and 'Reachable (api.resend.com:443): yes' with no visible smtp.gmail.com/587/465/SMTP wording; backend dry-run and live-send assertions passed using only jpmanchesteruk@gmail.com for the Resend testing-mode send.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill search for 'Rota email debug Resend SMTP shifts' returned no relevant testing skill. Tested preview URL https://jovial-hamilton-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend API login succeeded; dry-run POST /api/admin/shifts/debug-email for timperley-altrincham 2026-06-20..2026-06-26 returned transport=resend, resend_configured=true, reach_host=api.resend.com, reach_port=443, smtp_reachable=true. Live-send with override_to=jpmanchesteruk@gmail.com returned sent=1 and a result with sent=true/reason=sent. UI /jkhive/shifts rendered without 'Something went wrong'; [data-testid=shifts-print-rota] was present; [data-testid=email-debug-modal] showed Resend summary and hid SMTP wording.
rca_of_the_issue: Verified the user-visible regression is resolved end-to-end: the backend chooses Resend as active transport when RESEND_API_KEY is configured and the frontend conditionally renders Resend summary fields instead of SMTP host/port when data.transport === 'resend'.
